scope: Read-only network diagnosis after three user test clicks; no restart, no code or network configuration changes

findings.daemonLog: Repeated LOOM_PUSH_TEST_FAILED with ECONNRESET and no HTTP status; log timestamps unavailable, cannot uniquely map all lines to three clicks
findings.socketSnapshot: No outbound Mozilla socket remained at inspection; not proof against all leaks

independentNodeProbe.result: all timed out at 10 seconds after TCP connect, before secureConnect

findings.explicitSystemProxyProbe: Three HEAD requests through local system HTTP proxy timed out; third completed TLS at 5.81s but received no HTTP response by 10s
findings.control: www.mozilla.org via same proxy HTTP 200 in 0.269s

conclusion: Intermittent reachability to Mozilla push host reproduced independently of Loom and notification sends; HTTP 406 on root only proves transport recovered, not push acceptance. No evidence of HTTP 429 rate limit. Exact failing hop/policy remains unproven.
limits: Did not change Surge rules or exit node
Did not send additional actual push notifications
Need active Surge request rule/egress evidence to distinguish proxy policy, exit or remote failures
